description.value: The Parksville Branch of the Vancouver Island Regional Library has served the community since 1937, with its current Jensen Avenue location open since 2001 and refreshed aesthetically in 2019. It is part of the Vancouver Island Regional Library system, one of the largest public library systems in BC, offering public computers, free Wi-Fi, and bookable meeting rooms. Bike racks at all three building entrances make it a cyclist-friendly stop in the heart of Parksville.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website explicitly states 'Bike racks available at all 3 building entrances,' confirming bike parking. OSM tags internet_access=wlan and internet_access:fee=no indicate free Wi-Fi, consistent with the website's mention of public computers. Washrooms, water refill, showers, and most other amenities are not referenced in either the website content or OSM tags, so those remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established public library with confirmed bike racks at all three entrances and free Wi-Fi; a practical and culturally notable rest stop for touring cyclists passing through Parksville.

Bike parking.detail: Website states: 'Bike racks available at all 3 building entrances.'

wow_evidence: Branch since 1937 with bike racks at every entrance; ordinary library band.
